## Appearance

Harcourt is a red-haired woman with a long crimson plait worn in sleek, glossy waves. She has a small, pointed chin, a scandalously freckled nose, and sweet lips. Her face is featured by large, magnificent, and luminous eyes alongside glowing cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), +2 more_

## Personality

Ann Harcourt possesses an extremely poor temper. Because of this, she is required to learn how to control her temper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046)_

## Quotes

> "I could assist you so greatly at present and save you effort in numerous manners. For that single reason, I could truly desire to have been one."
>
> — Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> "If I were traveling by car, I would bring you. However, I plan to go on foot, a distance too great for legs belonging to an eight-year-old. Furthermore, Cedric will accompany me, and I suspect his presence does not bring you pleasure."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)

> "Upon seeing him on the playground, he was so soaked that I dispatched him straight home to get dressed before I could learn the reason."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P6](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0006)

> "Emptiness is the absolute worst thing . . . and my departure from your existence is not happening. Letters and vacations do exist, after all. My dear, you appear somewhat pale and exhausted, I fear."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0033)

> "Belinda, it seems to me that Miss Rosalind requires a change of scenery. Her time spent here in solitude is far too great. Is there no way we can persuade her to take a short journey?"
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P46](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0046)

## Relationships

### [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harcourt--miss-pembroke.md)

[Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) is a frequent visitor and favorite companion of Harcourt at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). The two share a close friendship that has lasted since the first volume.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

- Friend of — frequent visitor and favorite companion at Beechwood  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)</sub>

### [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/belinda--harcourt.md)

[Belinda](../character/belinda.md) and Harcourt are close friends residing in the same household. During trips to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), they spend time together picking strawberries, discussing the failing health and mood of Miss Rosalind, and delighting in romantic milestones such as Rosalind's reunion and wedding, continuing to catch up when reunited in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), +10 more_

- Friend of — close friends residing in the same household (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--harcourt.md)

Harcourt served as an instructor and mentor to [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), forming a warm connection with him on her first day teaching in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) when he gifted her wild orchids. They shared outings to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and discussed romantic developments surrounding his family, though over time [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) has begun growing out of his childhood fantasies.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), +10 more_

- Mentor of — former instructor to Cedric (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)</sub>
